fault: a crash after the insert and before the caller gets the answer: crash_after on the D1 run, or crash_before at the response point (the seed decides which is found first)
description: An inventory entrypoint's reserve() method inserts the reservation and returns it. Cloudflare does not retry an RPC call, but the calling Worker resends one it got no answer for, so a crash between the insert and the answer makes the resend reserve the order twice.
